content.title: Continuous Obstacle Route | Persistent Failure State and Reunion
content.summary: Send one clearly adult participant toward a visible adult counterpart or delivery goal through at least three obstacle materials that require different body strategies. Include one recoverable fall, preserve the resulting wet or dusty state across later obstacles, keep identity and route geography continuous, and end by completing both the physical route and its social or delivery purpose.

quick_start.input_format: one clearly adult participant and a fixed destination direction + at least three obstacle materials requiring different body strategies + one recoverable fall or immersion + persistent visible failure state + recovery inside the same route without resetting place or identity + environmental arrival signal and waiting adult or delivery goal close together
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult greenhouse seed courier carries one silver capsule across floating irrigation pads, shallow water, a rotating maintenance pipe, suspended inspection straps and separated concrete posts. The courier remains visibly wet after a fall, then reaches an adult botanist and hands over the same capsule as pollination drones rise.
required_anchors: Establish one adult participant, one destination direction and a shared obstacle environment before the first crossing.
Use at least three material obstacle classes that require different body strategies.
Show recovery inside the route and continue without resetting location or identity.
Resolve the destination through an environmental arrival cue and a waiting adult or delivery target.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Send one clearly adult participant toward a visible adult counterpart or delivery goal through at least three obstacle materials that require different body strategies. Include one recoverable fall, preserve the resulting wet or dusty state across later obstacles, keep identity and route geography continuous, and end by completing both the physical route and its social or delivery purpose.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one original clearly adult participant, one continuous destination direction and one shared obstacle environment before the first crossing. Chain at least three materially different obstacle classes so each requires a different body strategy, and preserve camera, wardrobe and environmental continuity between them. Include one recoverable fall or immersion that leaves an observable state such as wet clothing, mud or dust; show the adult recovering inside the route and retain that state through all later obstacles. End only after an environmental response marks arrival and a waiting adult or concrete delivery target resolves the promised destination. The reusable mechanism is continuous route, locomotion-class escalation, failure-state persistence, in-route recovery and terminal reunion—not the source woman, man, faces, costumes, water garden, lotus pads, log, ropes, stones, birds, romance, mythology, choreography, camera path, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one adult participant, one destination direction and a shared obstacle environment before the first crossing.
invariants.purpose: Turns separate stunts into one coherent route with a measurable goal.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without route geography, the sequence reads as unrelated obstacle inserts.

invariants.rule: Use at least three material obstacle classes that require different body strategies.
invariants.purpose: Creates genuine escalation through motion change rather than visual decoration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeating the same jump cannot prove adaptive progress.

invariants.rule: Include one recoverable fall or immersion and preserve its visible state afterward.
invariants.purpose: Gives failure a cumulative physical consequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Instantly dry or clean continuity erases the route history.

invariants.rule: Show recovery inside the route and continue without resetting location or identity.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the failure causally connected to later effort.
invariants.ablation_failure: A recovery cut to a new scene breaks the one-route promise.

invariants.rule: Resolve the destination through an environmental arrival cue and a waiting adult or delivery target.
invariants.purpose: Provides both spatial and narrative proof of completion.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on the last obstacle leaves the motive unresolved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source adult woman and man, faces, bodies, hair, clothing, styling, expressions and relationship
the source Chinese-fantasy water garden, bamboo, pavilion, red lanterns, sunrise and exact route layout
the source lotus pads, log, hanging ropes, stones, birds and obstacle choreography
the source wet-costume appearance, falls, crawling, gestures, meeting pose, camera path and 30-second timing
the source creator identity, mythic reunion premise, Seedance 2.5 claim, watermark, prompt text and branding
